Dear Madam
If my [coadjutors](../persons.html#229) can make room your paper shall go [in](../others.html#52) but there is a sad crowd of appeals

yours truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: ‘Coadjutors’ presumably means [A.D.

Innes](../persons.html#744) and [Christabel Coleridge](../persons.html#329), and suggests the letter dates from about 1893.
